Corrected the stale module header (the old text described only the replica case and predated the caller gate #1521 added) and the stale fetchGrants doc comment.
Absent coopMode defaults to null, so single-player and every non-co-op mount keep the previous behaviour exactly.

ownerDecisionsLeftOpen.question: Should a co-op GUEST's dashboard render the share panel at all?
ownerDecisionsLeftOpen.status: OPEN - deliberately NOT answered by this lane.
ownerDecisionsLeftOpen.whatThisFixDidAndDidNot: The fix stops the guest ASKING, so the failing request and the live Revoke buttons beside the fetched grant rows are both gone (the grant list is empty, and CampaignSharePanel renders no revoke affordance for an empty list). It does NOT change what the guest is TOLD: on a shared server the guest's stored authority is still `source` - it is literally the host's record - so the panel still renders the source variant, now as an empty share box rather than the 'you are a guest mirror' truth.
ownerDecisionsLeftOpen.whyNotDecidedHere: Answering it means deciding what a shared-server guest's stored authority SHOULD read, which is a campaign-replication design question, not part of the 403 this lane was asked to fix.
